coder_notes: Paediatric and young adult (0-21 years) multi-tumour basket; GBM eligible only in Part 1 (relapsed/refractory). Part 2 enrols treatment-naive melanoma and relapsed Hodgkin lymphoma; treatment_setting coded recurrent as the GBM-relevant Part 1 is relapsed/refractory (trial overall includes 'newly diagnosed' in the official title for Part 2 melanoma). Both antibodies are dose-determined as a combination, so both experimental_combination. BRAF mutation in melanoma is permissive, not a requirement, so not recorded. PK is serum only; TIM-3 receptor occupancy in whole blood is target engagement.
